sources.source_name: Kraus Product Specifications - Standart PRO KHU100-30
sources.snippet: Standart PRO 30" undermount single bowl. Real 16-gauge T-304 stainless steel (TRU16 gauge certification). NoiseDefend soundproofing technology — heavy-duty sound dampening pads covering 80%+ of bottom and sides. Commercial-grade satin finish. Tight-radius corners. 10" deep basin. Engineered rear drain placement with sloped basin bottom. Includes stainless steel bottom grid and drain assembly. cUPC certified. Limited lifetime warranty.
sources.classification_reason: Manufacturer specs with specific gauge certification and material grade claims.

sources.snippet: Kraus is solid for the price. The 16-gauge claim is real — you can feel the thickness vs an 18-gauge. NoiseDefend pads work well — significantly quieter than cheap sinks without deadening. The satin finish hides scratches. Drain slope is well-engineered. For a DTC brand, they've earned respect. Not Elkay heritage-level, but excellent value. I'd recommend it to homeowners on a budget who want quality.
sources.classification_reason: Professional plumber opinion with material-level analysis.

sources.source_name: This Old House - Best Stainless Steel Kitchen Sinks
sources.snippet: Kraus Standart PRO consistently rated as best value stainless steel kitchen sink. Real 16-gauge construction verified. NoiseDefend technology provides excellent sound dampening. Deep 10" basin handles large pots. Commercial satin finish is practical — hides scratches better than mirror polish. Comes with accessories (grid, drain kit, towel) that competitors charge extra for. Limited lifetime warranty.
sources.classification_reason: Expert publication with specific product analysis and comparative context.

sources.snippet: 4.7/5 stars over 5,000+ reviews. Top positive themes: excellent build quality for price, thick steel, quiet operation, deep basin, good drain slope. Top negative themes: tight-radius corners collect grime (harder to clean than rounded), need to hand-dry to prevent water spots, clips for undermount are basic. No material failure reports.

bottom_line: Kraus Standart PRO KHU100-30 is the best-value 16-gauge stainless steel kitchen sink. TRU16 gauge certification is genuine — real 16-gauge T-304 stainless throughout. NoiseDefend sound dampening (80%+ coverage) is well-executed. Commercial satin finish practical for daily use. Deep 10" basin with engineered drain slope. Professional consensus: 'solid, thick, well-engineered for price.' Trade-offs: DTC brand with limited showroom presence, manufacturing in partner factories (China/Vietnam — specific facilities not identified), tight-radius corners collect grime, limited heritage vs established plumbing brands (Elkay 100+ years, Kohler 150+ years). Limited lifetime warranty — execution from DTC brand requires monitoring.
